title: Build the web viewer
lead: A plain TypeScript + canvas viewer, without a framework, that plays replay files with step, play, pause and seek.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** hosting (later tier); live matches through the WASM build, which v1 acceptance does not require (scope with the owner).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: v1 feature list, goal 6 and acceptance criterion C19: the terminal and web viewers both play the same replay file correctly.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - Web viewer directory: TypeScript sources, a static HTML page, and tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Replay parsing and the frame model are tested in TypeScript.
- For the shared fixture replay, the frame model at sampled cycles equals the terminal viewer's frame model.
- Seeking to cycle N equals stepping N times.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Gap: the TypeScript compiler and any test runner are dependencies that need owner approval (C13). Propose the minimum.
- Canvas drawing of cell ownership and execution pointers.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The web viewer tests pass.
- Manual: open the page, load the shared fixture replay, and step, play, pause and seek.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-web-viewer` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
